title: 집주인에게 계약 해지 알리기: 왜, 언제 나가요?
objective: You can end your lease by phone and give the reason with -(으)로 인해.
summary: A tenant phones his landlord to end his lease early, giving the reason with -(으)로 인해.
setting: A phone call. Michael, a tenant in unit 302, calls his landlord to say he has to move out early.

task.title: Practice ending a lease
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to fill in, choose, or write each answer.

words.meaning: to end (cancel) a contract before it finishes
words.exampleMeaning: I told the landlord that I would end the contract.
There are three months left on the contract.

words.meaning: a job transfer order from your company
words.exampleMeaning: I was transferred to the head office in Seoul.

words.meaning: rental deposit (returned when you move out)
words.exampleMeaning: I got my deposit back on the day I moved out.

words.example: 개인 사정으로 이번 모임에 못 가요.
words.exampleMeaning: I can't go to this meeting for personal reasons.

words.meaning: because of, due to (formal; noun + 로 after a vowel or ㄹ, 으로 after other consonants)
words.example: 공사로 인해 엘리베이터를 쓸 수 없습니다.
words.exampleMeaning: The elevator cannot be used due to construction.

dialogue.korean: 사장님, 안녕하세요. 302호 사는 마이클입니다. 다름이 아니라 계약 문제로 말씀드릴 게 있어서 전화드렸어요.
dialogue.meaning: Hello, sir. This is Michael from unit 302. I'm calling because I need to talk to you about my contract.

dialogue.korean: 회사 발령으로 인해 다음 달 말에 부산으로 이사를 가게 됐어요. 그래서 계약을 해지하고 싶습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Because my company is transferring me, I have to move to Busan at the end of next month. So I'd like to end the contract.

dialogue.korean: 아, 그래요? 계약 기간이 아직 6개월 남았잖아요.
dialogue.meaning: Oh, really? You still have six months left on the contract, though.

dialogue.korean: 네, 새 세입자를 구하는 데 저도 최대한 협조하겠습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Okay, I'll do my best to help you find a new tenant.

dialogue.korean: 고마워요. 보증금은 새 세입자가 들어오면 바로 돌려줄게요.
dialogue.meaning: Thanks. I'll return your deposit as soon as the new tenant moves in.

exercises: Fill in each blank with 로 인해 or 으로 인해: ① 집 근처 공사____ 너무 시끄러워서 이사하려고 해요. ② 부모님 건강 문제____ 고향에 돌아가야 해요. ③ 층간 소음____ 잠을 잘 못 자요.
Choose the right word (보증금 / 발령 / 사정): 이사 나가는 날 집주인이 ____을 돌려줬어요.
Answer in English based on the dialogue: Why is Michael moving out, and how long is left on his contract?
Write one sentence in Korean with -(으)로 인해: Tell your landlord you have to move out because of a family situation (가족 사정).
answers: ① 로 인해 (공사로 인해) ② 로 인해 (문제로 인해) ③ 으로 인해 (소음으로 인해)
His company is transferring him to Busan (회사 발령); six months are left on his contract.
가족 사정으로 인해 이사를 가야 해요. (가족 사정으로 인해 계약을 해지하고 싶습니다.)
